user.title: EchoLocal
user.description: Adds the satellite card to your dashboards. Your devices keep working without this.

assign_tone.name: Send a tone
assign_tone.description: Send a tone from the EchoLocal library to devices.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: The devices to send it to.

unassign_tone.name: Remove a tone
unassign_tone.description: Remove a tone from devices. It stays in the library.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: The devices to remove it from.

duck_room.name: Quieten the room
duck_room.description: Drop every player in the device's room that is playing, by that device's own music ducking setting. Runs on its own when the device hears its wake word; this is for trying it by hand.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: The devices whose rooms to quieten.

unduck_room.name: Restore the room
unduck_room.description: Put back what Quiet the room dropped. Runs on its own when the turn ends; this is for trying it by hand.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: The devices whose rooms to restore.
